review_description: Six months on and we are not getting feed in tarrif. The energy retailer says it is because Apex have not done the paperwork.   Apex global  solutions have failed to respond and every time I contact them they are not available say they will ring me but nothing happens.
The sales guy went to a lot of trouble to explain how and what I save from my bill. I have had two bill cycles now and have cut my bill down from $700 to $250.
